messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: GPU capacity exhausted in cluster us-east-1-prod. queue_depth=18642, pod_pending=412, tail_latency_p95=5.6s. autoscaler errors adding nodes. Paging on-call.

maya: acked — i'm oncall, jumping in. which nodegroup is failing?

sam: seeing repeated failures from the cluster-autoscaler: 
```
E0909 14:02:12 scaling.go:303] failed to create instance: RunInstances API error: InvalidLaunchTemplateVersion: Launch template version 3 does not exist
status code: 400, request id: abcdefg
```

kevin: also getting iam:PassRole denied when the autoscaler tries to attach instance profile for nodegroup-gpu-2. Error from ASG activity: 
`Failed to assume role arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-nodegroup-role: AccessDenied`

maya: :eyes: so two separate blockers: LT version mismatch + passrole denied. any taint/eviction logs?

liz: kubelet shows taint application failing on boot: `failed to add taint: node "ip-10-0-5-123" not found` — looks like nodes never register. ASG shows instances launching then terminating within ~90s.

ara: customer impact: multiple model-serving queues degraded; controller reports 70% of inference requests falling back to hosted-cpu pool (higher latency). alerting shows customer-facing error-rate up ~3%.

maya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) temporarily increase autoscaler max nodes for gpu pools to allow more parallel attempts, 2) manual create nodes using a known-good LT/v1, 3) open infra ticket to fix LT versioning, 4) escalate IAM PassRole to infra with logs. who can create manual nodes?

sam: i can spin up a manual nodegroup from the console using launch-template:v1 we pinned last week. doing that now. will tag it as emergency-hotfix.

incident-bot: NOTE: creating manual nodegroup will bypass autoscaler credentials; ensure bootstrap config with taint "redwood/gpu=true:NoSchedule" so only GPU workloads land.

kevin: sam — when you create nodes, set the instance profile to `redwood-nodegroup-role-v2-temp` (it has the correct attach permissions). i'm opening a quick IAM policy change request to allow PassRole for the autoscaler service principal.

sam: spun up 4 manual nodes (i-0a1b2c3d, i-0f1e2d3c, i-0a9b8c7d, i-012345678). they registered after ~60s. cluster now showing 220 GPUs available. pending pods draining queue.

maya: :thumbsup: good. monitoring queue length — it's dropping from 18.6k -> 9.2k in 7min. latency and error rate trending down.

liz: creating temporary firewall rule to allow kubelet bootstrap traffic from ASG, since one of the failing LT versions had a wrong SG that blocked the node register flow. adding note to postmortem.

ara: customer comms: outage impact window estimated 14:02 - 14:27 UTC. affected customers: 3 enterprise tenants experienced elevated latency; AS ramped fallbacks. drafting note for customer-success.

maya: handing off to kevin for follow-through: please coordinate IAM fix, reconcile launch template versions, and create playbook step to prevent LT drift. i'll remain oncall for verification.

kevin: ack — i'll own remediation and root-cause. immediate tasks: (a) roll LT to include correct SG and user-data (b) update autoscaler ASG config to target LT:v1 if v3 missing (c) apply IAM PassRole allowance for autoscaler role with least privilege, (d) add an autoscaler healthcheck so we alert earlier on LT/version failure.

pager-duty-bot: Handoff: maya -> kevin at 14:25 UTC. On-call rotation reminder sent.

maya: thanks team. next steps: add a canary to prevent accidental LT version deletes, add a quick runbook item to manually create emergency nodes, and validate there's no residual tainted nodes. closing pager for now once metrics stable.

sam: note saved in #incidents with tags: gpu, autoscaler, launch-template, iam, postmortem-needed.

incident-bot: Incident closed (status: mitigated) at 14:27 UTC. Follow-up: postmortem assignment to kevin, timeline capture required, customer comms draft to be reviewed by CS.
